lines.text: Not shown to be profitable after fees. The book failed the requirement that its bootstrap test of return per capital-day passes Holm (p = 0.0967). Figures: net $+36,983.30 on £10,000, return per capital-day +0.3751%, 630 trades, maximum drawdown 47.26% at the bars' lows, against the equal-weight hold's 74.55%, smallest detectable return per capital-day +0.7626%. The book reached the trader's 8% halt on 2021-01-12: trading it would need the halt changed. Development only: not evidence for enabling anything.
